what: browserscan.net once per WEBGL_debug_renderer_info string, via a getParameter override injected before the page scripts (tools/fingerprint/browserscan-gpu-sweep.mjs).
finding: The renderer string alone decides it, and only by whether it contains the literal "SwiftShader". 32/32 runs: SwiftShader present => 0 skeletons and a real score; absent => 45 skeletons, 15 blank rows and a meaningless 100%. Apple, Metal, ANGLE, Unspecified Version and the vendor string are all innocent -- NVIDIA and Intel strings stall the same way, and the untouched Apple pair finishes once "SwiftShader" is appended to it.
method_control: The swiftshader variant reproduces results/macos-claim-isolation-linux-renderer-strings.json (0 skeletons, 90%) exactly, which is what makes the injected override stand in for a rebuild.
determinism: m-bare, m-phrase-only and d-metal-renderer-noangle were each run three times, interleaved, with identical results.
